package: R9-C1 external normalization correction (private plan 2026-11-19 section 6.1)
exposure_status: correction of an already-exposed external evaluation (GSE151530 scored once in a4_external_v1); not a blind or independent test
cohort: GSE151530 HCC samples only (25 donors / 32 samples / 50,023 cells); grouped by author patient
training: all 10 GSE149614 donors; representation ALL__full / ALL__excl_<target> (same select(obs, cond, 'ALL', seed) as v1)
selected_version_note: unchanged from v1 (source-only C2 rule); external labels select nothing in v2

normalization.v1_external_bug: external counts restricted to the 2,000 source HVGs BEFORE CP10k+log1p (library = HVG counts only)
normalization.corrected: external raw counts aligned to the full shared unique-symbol list (same list/order as the source), library = sum over that list, CP10k+log1p, then the source HVG columns, then the source scaler -> PCA50 -> PC scaler
normalization.shared_symbol_rule: symbols unique in both cohorts, sorted (v1 a1_repr.py); length must equal v1 ALL__meta.json n_shared_unique_symbols

representation_T1.on_pass: compatible: heads fitted on the stored v1 source Z; Replay input = stored v1 Z_ext; Corrected input = corrected external matrix through the rebuilt transform
representation_T1.on_fail: rebuilt: heads fitted on the rebuilt source Z; Replay input = external counts with the v1 (HVG-only) normalization through the rebuilt transform; Corrected = corrected normalization through the same rebuilt transform; calibration from a new 3-group source OOF on the rebuilt Z (mandatory)

prediction_replay_T2.unit: (condition, seed, model) on all 50,023 external cells, raw (pre-temperature) class probabilities of the refit head on the Replay input vs the stored v1 ext_logp

calibration_policy.rule: per task (condition, seed): if T1 passed and all 7 models of the task pass T2 -> reuse the v1 source-OOF logp of that task (temperature grid fit + tau_fine/tau_parent with EPS 0.02, exactly as v1 a4_eval) for both Replay and Corrected; otherwise -> new 3-donor-group source OOF (same groups, all 7 models, same Z as the final heads) in run a4_external_norm_v2_oof and the new T/tau applied to BOTH Replay and Corrected of that task. v1 calibration is kept only for the Original column.

evaluation_units.class_evaluable_rule: >=10 positives of that class in the external donor (unchanged)
evaluation_units.missing_values: kept as NA with reason; never dropped or set to 0

versions: corrected (same head and calibration as replay + corrected external input)
contrasts.primary: Corrected - Replay on the v1 primary metric (nat: all-mapped donor-macro AUPRC; sparse: target AUPRC) for the selected model LR_donor in each of the 4 conditions
contrasts.aggregation: seeds averaged within external donor; donor paired bootstrap 10,000 resamples (seed 0) -> mean, 95% percentile CI, per-donor sign counts
contrasts.multiplicity: primary family of 4 (LR_donor x 4 conditions): Bonferroni-simultaneous 98.75% percentile CI reported next to the 95% CI
contrasts.secondary: same contrast for the other 6 heads and all metrics; decomposition Corrected-Original = (Corrected-Replay) + (Replay-Original) for every condition x model x metric
contrasts.practical_threshold_note: plan section 2.3 proposal for R9 (not a v1 threshold); describes magnitude only, selects nothing
contrasts.interpretation: correction is complete when the contract, provenance and the 2,100-key evaluation are complete and drift is separated from the normalization effect, regardless of score direction. A11 external scores do not change the v1 source-based selection.
